We conduct Test of Factuality evaluation on Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) -a popular platform for workers (both experts and non-experts) to perform "micro-tasks" (in our case, instance annotations) on explanations generated by the Mistral-7B model on 300 instances of the Abt-Buy dataset.
guideline: For every instance, we ask annotators the following two questions related to the types of observed errors in reasoning explanations: Intrinsic Errors: Is the explanation fully derivable from the input entities and their corresponding matching label, irrespective of whether it contains excess information? Extrinsic Errors: Does the explanation contain information in excess of the entity descriptions and their corresponding matching labels?
